exposure: COVID-19 pandemic situation during pregnancy and postpartum
cohort: The study compared two cohorts of mothers: one whose data was collected pre-COVID-19 pandemic, and another whose data was collected at the beginning of the pandemic, both followed during pregnancy and postpartum.
finding: The study found no significant differences in depressive symptoms or anxiety, but observed higher maternal bonding and lower maternal self-confidence in the pandemic cohort compared to the pre-pandemic cohort.
mod_finding: The quality of postpartum maternal bonding and maternal self-confidence were influenced by the mode of birth in the pandemic cohort.
